## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The pull-request description should document verification as project policy requires. This review read the tests without running them and found an optional coverage correction for numeric titles.

## Changes
Adds a helper that lowercases titles, replaces runs outside ASCII letters and digits with hyphens, and trims surrounding hyphens. Adds parameterized tests for capitalization, separators, and empty results.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- PR body — correctness — Add the required Testing section — The description contains no verification section, violating AGENTS.md:4: “Every pull-request description has a `## Testing` section that says how the change was verified.” — Reviewers lack the verification record required by the project's contribution policy.

## Suggestions
- app/slug.py:7 — tests — Cover digits in page titles — A title such as `Release 2026` exercises digit preservation, but none of the existing tests contains digits despite the explicit `0-9` range. — Removing digit support could pass the current tests and change URLs for numbered page titles. — Fix: Extend `test_slugify` with a title containing digits.
